item.title: [Featured Article] Zombie Nightmare
item.description: Zombie Nightmare is a 1987 Canadian zombie film produced and directed by Jack Bravman, written by John Fasano, and starring Adam West, Jon Mikl Thor, Tia Carrere, Frank Dietz, and Linda Singer. The film centres on a baseball player who is killed by a group of teenagers and resurrected as a zombie by a voodoo priestess. The zombie goes on to kill the teenagers, whose deaths are investigated by the police. The film was shot in the suburbs of Montreal. It was originally written to star mostly black actors, but at the request of investors, the characters' names were changed to more typically white names. While Bravman was credited as director, Fasano directed the majority of the film; problems occurred between Fasano and the production crew, who believed him to be the assistant director and ignored his instructions.

item.title: [In the News] US$6.3 billion is stolen from cryptocurrency exchange Binance.
item.description: On 29 October 2026, US$6.3 billion worth of digital assets were stolen from Binance, a cryptocurrency exchange, allegedly by the North Korea-linked hacking group TraderTraitor. The exchange hack is the largest ever cryptocurrency heist, surpassing the $1.5 billion Bybit hack in 2025, with the most affected blockchains being that of Ethereum and Bitcoin. Binance, having initially halted all trades, has stated it will cover all losses, while approximately $3 billion of the stolen stablecoins have been frozen. The exchange further announced that it intends to resume withdraw services for customers on 1 November and that they will show proof of reserves on 2 November. The United States Secret Service has said that it is working to recover the stolen assets.

item.title: [In the News] Mexican politician Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas dies at the age of 92.
item.description: Cuauhtémoc Cárdenas Solórzano was a Mexican statesman and civil engineer. The son of President Lázaro Cárdenas (1934–1940), he was known for his contributions to Mexico's democracy and his 1988 presidential campaign. Cárdenas was regarded as one of the leading leftist figures in Mexico and in Latin America.

item.title: [In the News] British actor Patrick Stewart dies at the age of 86.
item.description: Sir Patrick Stewart was an English actor. With a career spanning over 60 years on stage and screen, he received numerous accolades, including two Laurence Olivier Awards and a Grammy Award, as well as nominations for a Tony Award, three Golden Globe Awards, four Emmy Awards, and three Screen Actors Guild Awards. He was knighted by Queen Elizabeth II for his services to drama in 2010.

item.title: [In the News] In baseball, the Milwaukee Brewers defeat the Tampa Bay Rays to win the World Series.
item.description: The 2026 World Series was the championship series of Major League Baseball's (MLB) 2026 season. The 122nd edition of the World Series, the best-of-seven playoff series was played from October 23 to 28 by the American League (AL) champion Tampa Bay Rays and the National League (NL) champion Milwaukee Brewers, who defeated the Rays in five games to win their first championship. Brewers catcher William Contreras was named the World Series Most Valuable Player (MVP) after batting .381 and going 10-for-13 on Automated Ball-Strike System (ABS) challenges in the series.

item.title: [In the News] At least 69 people are killed in a collision between two high-speed trains in Toledo province, Spain.
item.description: On 28 October 2026 at 08:54 CET (UTC+01:00), an AVE high-speed train collided end-on with a stationary Iryo high-speed train in Los Yébenes, Toledo, on the Madrid–Seville high-speed rail line, killing at least 69 people. Both trains involved in the crash were travelling from Atocha station in Madrid to Santa Justa station in Seville.
